content: Jesús mi̱sadedani̱ vanubay ja̱mura pa̱chityi̱
Tarundamu ji̱ta jiryatiy jiituyada runda ravicha̱da, sajayadanumatiy Jesús jibyedaju̱ sarorivyimu Varyisévuveda nutyityu̱, ru̱nu̱choda Varyisévuveda variy jasiñi̱.
Savichanu̱yada ti̱qui jdiva̱jni̱ sadiya, ja̱mura pa̱chityi̱.
Sitaja̱doda ji̱ta Jesús variryi Ju̱denu niquejada datyanuvay, Varyisévuveda jarye: “¿Samiryavidye Ju̱denu diya, mi̱sadeda jiituyada rundamu, varimyatamu̱y?”
Rime̱cho̱jada mitya vajeryade variy. Sapu̱cheda ji̱ta Jesús variñi̱ jdiva̱jni̱, sami̱sadeda variñi̱, su̱mu̱rya̱da ji̱ta variy jadchiñi̱.

Sitaja̱doda ji̱ta Jesús variryi: “¿Ne jiryeñi jvaay jiituyada rundamuntiy? ¿Mi̱ra jiryetyenu ne saryi sipyata varicha̱ra̱ju̱ni̱ jidyenu varimyata savoca, mi̱ra? saryityi ju̱u̱y jiituyada rundamu jmuchaju̱vimu.”
Ne vana̱y ru̱mutya̱jada variy ranchiy.
Ja̱mu̱yada vichtyamuju̱ musuchavay

Su̱nu̱yadanumatiy Jesús jiryatiy rijeryetanu̱yada musuchavarya ma̱sajo rorijya̱mi̱tuunu rirya̱tidye dityanura jivyicha̱da jaryiñuvay jityevamyusiy, satu̱choda ji̱ta variy ruuvara datyadoda niquejada. Su̱teda ji̱ta ruuva: “Ti̱tiy raryi musuy ja̱mu̱jyomuju̱ ji, ne ya̱ma̱sanuve vase vadi ja̱mu̱ñutuunu, saryityi ju̱ti̱ ti̱ jaryiñu̱va̱ju̱ yimusiy, sa̱jti̱ ja̱mu̱yada ja̱mi̱ variy yimu, sa̱jtay variy yiva: Ya̱sa̱y jimya̱sajoni̱. Ya̱jo̱ta ji̱ta variy va̱ta̱da tamitya ma̱sajona̱cho̱ yana̱danube.

Sa̱numatiy musuy ti̱ ji, ya̱ntya ma̱sanuve ji̱ta tamitya ma̱sajoncha, sa̱tidye jtañuvi̱ vadi ja̱mu̱ñu jasiy yiva: Jaamyicyu, ya̱ma̱sa ratyuunudera, jityidye ra̱cha jchana̱tyasi̱ ridyiya musuchavay ti̱ta̱ju̱ variy.
Tapi mi̱ni̱tyi jchana̱tya nu̱tyu jaryiñu̱yu, sa̱cha jantanichi̱ riva, daryaday mi̱ni̱tyi jtay jidyetya pasidyeva̱ju̱, sa̱cha ji̱ta jchana̱tyasi̱ rivantidye.”

Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy siva jimyusubyintiy: “Ya̱numatiy jvaarya vichtya, ne ya̱musuy variryi jijemyicyuveda, dantyamu̱y ne jityeryi̱veda, dantyamu̱y ne jiryena̱miy, dantyamu̱y ne jityuunu vichavay jaryi taratavay, riñuma musuy ramurichiryantidye ji.
Ya̱numatiy jvaarya vichtya, ya̱ma̱ musuy ji̱ta riy jantyuyadavay, pa̱ñimyi, canuya̱simyi, ni̱sipyuryimyi jarye ruusa̱ju̱.
Jaryi jchana̱tyasi̱ ji̱ta ye̱cha variy, jiryatimyu̱ ne vana̱y rimyurichenu ramurichirya ji, tii, mitya. Ya̱day ji̱ta jmutya̱ra ramurichirya, vase vichavay mi̱sa̱subeda rundamu.”
Jesús tu̱choda ja̱mu vichtyanchiy
Satuva̱chodanumatiy ti̱qui Jesúsjsa̱ musuchi̱ra saniquejada, su̱teda variy siva: “Jchana̱tyasi̱ ji̱ta sa̱cha, ni̱tiy ra̱jmyi Ju̱denu nusu̱jyomu.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy siva: “Ta̱riy savichanu̱yada ti̱qui vanu. Sivaayada ji̱tara ja̱mu vichtya rajuuvay musuchavajyu̱.
Vichtya rundamu ji̱ta su̱pa̱jadani̱ jimyuchechiy ruumu musuchavay, sa̱tidye jtay ruuva: Jirya̱numa jiya vichtyamu, jdutyasaranuma daryaju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ra.

Rijyo̱ta̱da ji̱ta jteda variy siva vichtya ja̱mi̱ muchechiy, jiryatimyu̱ ne vana̱y nta rirye̱jiya. Su̱teda munatya musuchi̱ siva muchechiy: Ratye̱ryu̱mya̱ diyedera nudiy, ra̱jnu̱jedyi riva. Rajechiñu̱y yiva sa̱ma̱ ramityaniy vichtya ja̱mi̱ mitya rivara.
Su̱teda ji̱ta nu̱ntiy: Ratye̱ryu̱mya̱ vu̱yaju̱y voca, ra̱jnu̱jedyiryi. Rajechiñu̱y yiva sa̱ma̱ ramityaniy mitya rivara.
Su̱teda ji̱ta nu̱ntiy: Rajya̱mu̱mya̱ ravyaturaju̱, ramuni̱mu̱y ne vana̱y ra̱jiya.

Satu̱chunuvi̱jada ji̱ta muchechiy variy siva jipyatru̱ra riñiquejada. Satuva̱chodanumatiy rorijya̱mi̱ra, su̱teda ji̱ta jamiryamu siva jimyuchechiy variy: Vani̱ra jaryuve ye̱jiya vicha̱da cabyiva, ja̱mu nú̱va, racu̱siñu̱deva jarye, jiipyu̱chitya̱ta vani̱ra rumusiryi jantyuyadavay, pa̱ñimyi jarye, canuya̱sivyeda jarye ruusa̱ju̱.
Satu̱chunuvi̱jada ji̱ta muchechiy siva jipyatru̱ntiy: Rito̱tanimya̱ra yiteda, jasidye ji̱tara vidavijontiy.
Su̱teda ji̱ta variy siva jimyuchechiy: Ye̱jiya ja̱munú̱quiva, mantyanú̱va jarye, ya̱tidye jaryuvu̱ryi nijya̱nvay rumusiy, ra̱tidye mu̱cha̱siy raryoriy variy rijyu̱.
Ri̱tatye si̱tenute yivacu̱, ¡ne sa̱jmyi ti̱ musuchavay tenute ravyichtyamu, tii, mitya!”
Vu̱ryi rrachu ti̱ta̱ju̱ra vu̱berya, Jesús siityari̱sa̱daju̱

Riya̱danumatiy rajuuvay nijya̱nvay sisa̱ Jesús, sa̱numityejada ji̱ta variy riñe̱cho̱ju̱, su̱teda variy ruuva: “Ni̱tiy siityari̱ru̱rye, netimyu̱ sa̱va̱tasara jaryivya̱ju̱ nadimusiy jijye̱jyu̱rye, savaturu̱y jarye nadisa̱ju̱, sataryi̱veda, si̱tyamutuveda jarye ti̱ta̱ju̱, jo, su̱nu̱yadasa̱ra̱ju̱, ne vana̱y sa̱chasara risa̱ datyi̱.
Mi̱ni̱tyimyu̱ ne nichusara jidyiiyadajiju̱ra crusiy, dantyamu̱y ne sasiityari̱tityi varirye, ne vana̱y sa̱chasara risa̱ datyi̱.
Tapi mi̱ra jiryetyenu, saryityi roriiryu̱rya panu̱chavu̱, ¿ne viy sa̱ma̱sa munatya jimyi̱saniy, ramurichirya suradodaju̱, rasa̱ra̱numaviy rani̱cha criquiy, ratatiy saryi ca̱sirya panu̱chavu̱?
Netimyu̱ ne saryi suranu samirya ramurichirya, saryiñumatiy jo̱ta roriiyada, netimyu̱ ne vana̱y nta sa̱ca̱sirya, riryi jo̱ta jarupanta̱da tavañi̱, jiryatiy ridyi riva sadatya̱da su̱tyeda.
Riryi jtay ji̱ta variy: Sani jo̱tama̱ ji̱ta roriiyada, ne vana̱y ntate saca̱sirya.

Daryadantyi, ¿mi̱ra ja̱mu nutyityu̱, mi̱? saryityi datya: Su̱niñuma ratarya nutyityu̱ vu̱ñe̱cho̱, daraju̱y vu̱yaju̱y vara̱nca su̱tarumitya, ne viy sa̱ma̱sa munatya, sa̱tidye jachipiya̱ samiy: ‘Vana̱vyidye vurya̱suru̱y vu̱yaju̱y vara̱nca su̱tarumitya rijyu̱.’
Vu̱ryityi datya: Ne vu̱cha̱ra̱vay ntate day, ripyapudetidye riryicha vu̱myityasimyi, vu̱ryi jpa̱ riy vu̱nsu̱vye rimyo̱muju̱, rirya̱tidye jdutya nu̱ñi mityasivyedara.
Ramuni̱tiy, mi̱ni̱tyi jiryetyenu, netimyu̱ ne sajachipiya̱ samiy sa̱tidye rrachura jiberya ti̱ta̱ju̱, ne vana̱y sa̱chasara risa̱ datyi̱ variñu̱ndye.”
Jesús tu̱choda tivyi tivyijyu̱vyedanchiy
“Tivyi ji̱ta samirya. Varityi ji̱ta raryi baryi̱ rativyijyu̱vyeda, ¿nu̱tyuramusiña̱ vu̱ryi ta̱ryataniy tivyijyu̱ryaju̱ntirya, nu̱tyuramusiy?
Ne samirya mucadiju̱ra, mitya, dantyamu̱y ne voca ju̱vu̱dimuntiy. Vu̱ryi jatya mitya ruujyuuju̱ra. Daryani̱ ji̱ta savicha ni̱timyu̱ ne siityari̱ samirya. Jiryetyuva̱chuta̱ta tu̱yutavay.”
